steps.text: Plan a long journey using large-number estimation — start by choosing a travel speed.
Tap “80 km/day” or “100 km/day” to set your daily distance.
Watch how many days the journey takes at that speed — real distances add up fast!
Distance divided by speed gives the number of days. Estimating with large numbers helps plan real trips.

coach.mission: Plan the journey by choosing a daily distance.
whenStuck: Tap a speed like “80 km/day” to set your daily distance.
whenWrong: Days needed = distance ÷ speed. Estimate that to choose a sensible speed.
A bigger daily distance means fewer days — pick accordingly.
coach.done: You can plan journeys with big-number estimation. Keep exploring, or move on.
